//==
// # Proximity queries
//
// Nearest-neighbor, radius, and closest-point requests with their result
// records. Distances are world-space and non-negative; a MaxDistance that is
// zero or negative means "unbounded", and a MaxCount of zero or less means
// unlimited.

// A k-nearest-neighbors request around a 2D point
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nearest_neighbor_search). NeighborCount is
// the maximum number of results; MaxDistance of zero or less means unbounded.
type KNearestQuery2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    NeighborCount: Integer;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}
